under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 17th May, 2023 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No.KP/19 of 2023/PER/102019/665/KH:- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) of section 227 read 
with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the 
following rules further to amend the Deputy Chitnis, Class III in the superior Panchayat Service (Pre-service Training 
and Post-Training Examination) Rules, 2020, namely:- 
1. 
(1) These rules may be called the Deputy Chitnis, Class-III in the superior Panchayat Service (Pre-service 
Training and Post-Training Examination) (Amendment), Rules, 2023. 
(2) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.   
I-A Ex.-15 
15-1

blocks.text:
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
15-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 24-05-2023 
 [ PART  I-A 
2. 
In the Deputy Chitnis, Class-III in the superior Panchayat Service (Pre-service Training and Post-Training 
Examination) Rules, 2020, in rule-8,- 
(i) 
in sub-rule (2), for the words, “sixty percent”, the words, “fifty percent” shall be substituted; 
(ii) after sub-rule (2), the following sub-rule shall be inserted, namely:- 
“(2A) If the candidate has obtained less than fifty marks in any one paper out of five papers and secured 
fifty or more than fifty marks in four other papers, in such circumstances, maximum five (5) gracing marks 
shall be given and he shall be declared pass in the examination”. 
      By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
GOPALSINH YADAV, 
          Under Secretary to Government. 
-------------- 
 
Signed by:BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
